mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM user_information_tbl WHERE user_name = #{userName}
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM user_information_tbl WHERE mail_address = #{mailAddress}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_information_tbl ( user_name, mail_address, password, status, create_datetime, update_datetime, version ) VALUES ( #{user.userName}, #{user.mailAddress}, #{user.password}, #{user.status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_information_tbl SET password = #{encodedPassword}, update_datetime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
